facts.subject: Lich
facts.text: Level 15 to 16 is recommended for fighting Lich, and players struggling can grind levels in the giant's hallway on Earth Cave 1F or on the Peninsula of Power.

evidence.quote: Level 15 to 16 should be doable for most parties, but if you are losing a lot, you can consider going to the giant's hallway on the first floor of the Earth Cave or returning to the Peninsula of Power.

facts.subject: Crescent Lake
facts.text: After restoring the Earth Crystal, travelling to Crescent Lake allows you to obtain the Canoe, which immediately opens up Gurgu Volcano, the Ice Cave, and the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: Any route taken after the Earth Crystal is restored will first take you to the opposite side of the continent and the town of Crescent Lake, where you'll grab the canoe [achievement 3574]. Getting the Canoe opens up three dungeon areas immediately: Gurgu Volcano, Ice Cave, and the Castle of Ordeals.

facts.subject: Crescent Lake
facts.text: To reach the Castle of Ordeals, sail north along the coast past the Peninsula of Power, head west through the gap, proceed northwest past the desert into an inlet, enter the dark green river using the Canoe, disembark west, and walk through the western forest.

evidence.quote: Follow the coastline north from where you parked your ship near Crescent Lake until you see the familiar Peninsula of Power; go west through the gap, then proceed northwest past the large area of desert. The castle can be reached by sailing into the inlet above it and then trying to move down onto the darker green river; if you have the Canoe, you'll automatically anchor the ship and move onto the river in the canoe instead. From there, just move left to get onto solid ground and head through the western forest to arrive at the castle.

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 1F
facts.text: The entryway of Castle of Ordeals requires the Crown in order to proceed beyond the first floor.

evidence.quote: The Castle of Ordeals consists of an entryway followed by a teleporter maze floor and then a boss floor. The entry floor is empty; you'd be stopped from proceeding if you didn't have the Crown, but you got here in the first place, so you did indeed go get it.

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 2F
facts.text: Floor 2 of the Castle of Ordeals contains a chest in the top right room holding the Zeus Gauntlets, which cast Lit2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: Floor 2 (the teleporter maze) contains one chest in the top right room (containing the Zeus Gauntlets, which cast Lit2 when used in battle).

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 2F
facts.text: In the Castle of Ordeals teleporter maze, the correct pillars to take in order are the southern pillar, the southern pillar again, the eastern pillar, and the pillar furthest south.

evidence.quote: The correct choices are southern pillar at the first choice, southern pillar again at the second choice, eastern pillar at the third choice, and the pillar furthest south for the fourth.

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
facts.text: The top right treasure group on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contains the Heal Staff, which casts HEAL on use and requires fighting a guaranteed Nightmare encounter.

evidence.quote: top right: Heal Staff, grabbing it will require you to refight the guaranteed Nightmare encounter, casts HEAL on use

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
facts.text: The top left chests on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contain a Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, and Iron Gauntlet, while the bottom left chests contain a House, 1455 G, and 7340 G.

evidence.quote: top left: Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, Iron Gauntlet; bottom left: House, 1455 G, 7340 G).

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
facts.text: The throne room on Floor 3 of Castle of Ordeals contains the Tail in a chest, which is permitted to pick up even during a Merchandise Madness challenge run.

evidence.quote: Once you've gone around the floor counterclockwise, you'll arrive at a final room with a throne. The chest in here contains the **Tail**, which you're allowed to pick up even if you're running Merchandise Madness [achievement 398476].

facts.subject: Castle of Ordeals 3F
facts.text: Approaching the throne on Floor 3 triggers a fixed battle with one or two ZombieD, and stepping on the throne teleports the party back to the first floor to exit.

evidence.quote: Walking towards the throne will require you to fight a fixed encounter with one or two ZombieD; if you make it out of that, you can step on the throne to be teleported back to the first floor and leave the castle.

facts.subject: Crescent Lake
facts.text: To reach Gurgu Volcano from Crescent Lake, take the Canoe onto the river above town heading west, then take the west fork, north fork, east fork, west fork twice, and follow the path south.

evidence.quote: take your new Canoe onto the river above the town and head west. When you get to forks in the river, take the west fork, then the north one, then east, then west twice more, then follow the path when it bends south to arrive at the volcano.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 1F
facts.text: Lava floors on Gurgu Volcano 1F drain party health when walked on but prevent random encounters from triggering.

evidence.quote: Gurgu Volcano's first floor has nothing interesting except lava floors that will sap your health when you walk on them but will also not trigger random encounters.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 2F
facts.text: Gurgu Volcano Floor 2 contains a treasure chamber with 9 chests containing 6710 G, two Heal Potions, a Pure Potion, Cabin, Silver Gauntlet, Silver Helmet, Silver Shield, and Silver Axe.

evidence.quote: 9 of these are in one treasure chamber (containing 6710 G, Heal Potion, Heal Potion, Pure Potion, Cabin, Silver Gauntlet, Silver Helmet, Silver Shield, and Silver Axe).
The other 6 are scattered throughout the rest of the tunnels and usually guarded by forced encounters; you'll find 1520 G, Silver Helmet, 4150 G, Giant Sword, 795 G, and 650 G.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 2F
facts.text: Six additional chests scattered through the tunnels on Gurgu Volcano 2F contain 1520 G, a Silver Helmet, 4150 G, a Giant Sword, 795 G, and 650 G.

evidence.quote: The other 6 are scattered throughout the rest of the tunnels and usually guarded by forced encounters; you'll find 1520 G, Silver Helmet, 4150 G, Giant Sword, 795 G, and 650 G.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 3F
facts.text: From the entrance of Gurgu Volcano Floor 3, proceed east to reach Floor 4 south, go to the southeast corner back up to Floor 3, then head south, west, south, and west to reach the Floor 4 stairs.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 has no chests on it; proceed east from the floor 2 entrance to get down to floor 4 (south). This section of Floor 4 also has nothing interesting in it, so go to the southeast corner to go back to Floor 3. Floor 3 continues to have nothing going on, so proceed south, west, south again, and west to the Floor 4 stairs.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
facts.text: Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 North has a treasure room near the stairs with a Soft potion and 2750 G, along with another chest along the path containing 1760 G.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 (North) has a treasure room near the stairs you just went down (2 chests, Soft potion, 2750 G). Another treasure room you'll bump into along the path (one chest, 1760 G).

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
facts.text: A room to the northwest on Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 holds 5 chests containing 7340 G, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, 880 G, and a Pure potion.

evidence.quote: Heading northwest from there leads you to a room with 5 chests in it (7340 G, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, 880 G, Pure potion).

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
facts.text: On Gurgu Volcano Floor 4, a room at the fork has chests with 10 G and 155 G, and a room northeast of the fork contains a House and 2000 G.

evidence.quote: Leaving here and backtracking along the path, you'll run into a room at the fork of the path with two more chests (10 G, 155 G). Northeast of here is another chest room with two non-empty chests (House, 2000 G).

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 4F
facts.text: The southern chest room on Gurgu Volcano Floor 4 contains a Wooden Staff and 1250 G, adjacent to two guaranteed encounter tiles useful for grinding levels.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 (North) has a treasure room near the stairs you just went down (2 chests, Soft potion, 2750 G). Another treasure room you'll bump into along the path (one chest, 1760 G).
Heading northwest from there leads you to a room with 5 chests in it (7340 G, Flame Shield, Ice Sword, 880 G, Pure potion).

Leaving here and backtracking along the path, you'll run into a room at the fork of the path with two more chests (10 G, 155 G). Northeast of here is another chest room with two non-empty chests (House, 2000 G).

Go back to the fork again and head south along the path to find the last chest room on this floor (2 chests, Wooden Staff, 1250 G). This room is notable for having two guaranteed encounter tiles immediately adjacent to each other, so you can guarantee an encounter every step by walking up and down between them, which makes for a convenient way to grind some levels if you can kill the enemies quickly.

facts.subject: Gurgu Volcano 5F
facts.text: Floor 5 of Gurgu Volcano has one chest containing the Flame Armor to the west, guarded by an Agama along the passage and a Red D directly in front of the chest.

evidence.quote: Floor 5 has one chest, to the west of the entrance; you'll have to fight an Agama at the start of the candle-lined passage up to the chest, and the tile in front of the chest forces a further encounter with a Red D (significantly more dangerous). The chest contains the Flame Armor.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Kary has 600 max HP, hits 6 times with physical attacks, is weak to Status, neutral to Earth, Time and Death, and resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison.

evidence.quote: Kary statistics: 600 max HP, Weak to Status, Neutral to Earth, Time and Death, Resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison, physical attacks hit 6 times

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Kary has a 62.5% chance to make a physical attack and a 37.5% chance to cast magic, cycling through Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Hold.

evidence.quote: Kary has a 62.5% chance to make a physical attack and a 37.5% chance to cast magic, with her spell cycle being Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Hold.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Casting Hold on Kary paralyzes her with a roughly 10% chance to recover, while Slow permanently reduces her attacks per round to 1.

evidence.quote: Hold will Paralyze her, giving you completely free turns until Kary hits the roughly 10% chance to recover from it, while Slow will indefinitely reduce her number of attacks per round to 1, significantly blunting their impact.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: Kary resists fire, halving damage from elemental resistance and halving it again by failing the magic resistance check, resulting in Fire dealing roughly 5-10, Fir2 dealing 15-30, and Fir3 dealing 25-50 damage.

evidence.quote:
Kary has a decent attack power and the ability to throw multiple hits at her
targets.  That being said, her true power lies in her use of Fir2 and her
ability to stun your party members.
Kary statistics: 600 max HP, Weak to Status, Neutral to Earth, Time and Death, Resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison, physical attacks hit 6 times

The main issue is that Kary resists fire, so your spell's damage range is going to get halved by the elemental resistance, and then halved again by the fact that your spell is not going to pass the magic resistance check. This means Fire's damage range is roughly 5-10, Fir2 only manages 15-30, and Fir3 can get around 25-50.

facts.subject: Kary
facts.text: To defeat Kary with fire damage without the Flame Sword, players can slug it out until Kary has taken 500+ damage and then stall until finishing her off with fire magic.

evidence.quote: So you should cast Inv2 to help lessen Kary's blows, and Afir to counteract her Fir2 spell.  Fast should be employed on the fighting people because Kary's armor is very strong.
Kary has a 62.5% chance to make a physical attack and a 37.5% chance to cast magic, with her spell cycle being Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Dark -> Fir2 -> Hold -> Fir2 -> Hold.
You'll be focusing on slugging it out until Kary's taken 500+ damage and then stalling until you can manage to do enough damage with fire magic to finish her off.

facts.subject: Flame Sword
facts.text: The Flame Sword has 26-attack-power but functions as generic sword damage because its elemental alignment property does not function correctly, allowing a Fighter, Red Mage, or Ninja to defeat Kary with it.

evidence.quote: If you *have* been to the Ice Cave already, your Fighter/Red Mage/Ninja can swing a Flame Sword. This weapon, like all other weapons that are supposed to be elementally aligned or super-effective against a family of monsters, is instead entirely generic because its special property doesn't function correctly, so you won't be doing any less damage than with any other 26-attack-power sword; just buff up your sword wielder of choice (as long as you didn't choose Thief, because they don't get to equip it until after class changing) and swing until you win.

facts.subject: Ice Cave
facts.text: To reach the Ice Cave from Crescent Lake port, sail north to dock or enter the river, head west by canoe into the interior, take the north path at the four-way river intersection, turn east at the fork, continue west around the corner, take the west fork, and head south.

evidence.quote: Sail north from the Crescent Lake port and either dock at the next port up or just sail directly into the river in the bay; either way you'll be getting on your canoe to head west into the interior of the continent again. From the four-way river intersection, head north, go east at the next fork, continue around the corner and keep west, take the west fork when you get to it, and continue south around the next corner to arrive at the Ice Cave.

facts.subject: Floor 1
facts.text: The first floor of the Ice Cave has nothing immediately accessible, requiring players to take the stairs down to Floor 2 (west).

evidence.quote: Ice Cave's first floor has nothing immediately accessible, so take the stairs down to Floor 2 (west).

facts.subject: Floor 2 (west)
facts.text: Proceed to the bottom left corner of Floor 2 (west) to reach Floor 3 (East).

evidence.quote: Nothing interesting here either, just proceed to the bottom left corner of the floor to reach Floor 3 (East).

facts.subject: Floor 3 (East)
facts.text: Floor 3 (East) contains two sets of stairs leading up, where taking the stairs not previously used leads to Floor 2 (east).

evidence.quote: This room's just two sets of stairs up, so go to the ones you didn't come from. This will lead to Floor 2 (east).

facts.subject: Floor 2 (east)
facts.text: Walking around the holes in the interior treasure room of Floor 2 (east) to the top-left chest awards the Flame Sword.

evidence.quote: The interior treasure room of this floor has 3 treasure chests, but you're only going to be able to grab two of them coming from this entrance; walking around the holes to the top-left chest will earn you the Flame Sword (which, if you haven't beaten Kary yet, could be taken out of here and used to fight her more conveniently as long as you have somebody who can wield it).

facts.subject: Floor 2 (east)
facts.text: The top-right chest in the Floor 2 (east) treasure room contains Clothes, guarded by a forced encounter with Mages.

evidence.quote: Going around to the top-right chest will result in a forced encounter with some Mages (particularly nasty random encounter foes) and a chest that contains Clothes (particularly insulting reward for the trouble).

facts.subject: Floor 2 (east)
facts.text: Stepping into any pit in the treasure room of Floor 2 (east) drops the party into the starting room of Floor 3 (West).

evidence.quote: In order to get that last one, you'll have to step into one of the pits in the treasure room, which all land in the same place: the starting room of Floor 3 (West).

facts.subject: Floor 3 (West)
facts.text: The room west of the starting room on Floor 3 (West) contains 2 chests holding a Silver Gauntlet and Ice Armor, guarded by a forced encounter with 1 to 2 Frost D.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 (West) has a couple more treasure rooms in it, one to the west of the starting room (2 chests, Silver Gauntlet, Ice Armor, guarded by forced encounter with Frost D x1-2) and one at the far south of this floor (6 chests, 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, 12350 G, forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right side chests).

facts.subject: Floor 3 (West)
facts.text: The treasure room at the far south of Floor 3 (West) contains 6 chests with 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, and 12350 G, with a forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right chests.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 (West) has a couple more treasure rooms in it, one to the west of the starting room (2 chests, Silver Gauntlet, Ice Armor, guarded by forced encounter with Frost D x1-2) and one at the far south of this floor (6 chests, 7900 G, 5450 G, 180 G, 9900 G, 5000 G, 12350 G, forced FrWolf gang encounter between the two right side chests).

facts.subject: Floor 1 (West)
facts.text: Floor 1 (West) contains 5 chests containing a Heal potion, 10000 G, 9500 G, a Tent, and an Ice Shield, as well as a hole to drop through.

evidence.quote: The stairs up are at the southeast part of the room, leading back to Floor 1 but in the west portion this time. This part of the floor has 5 total chests (Heal potion, 10000 G, 9500 G, Tent, Ice Shield) and a hole to drop through.

facts.subject: Floor 2 (East)
facts.text: Dropping down the pit in Floor 1 (West) lands the party on Floor 2 (East) in front of the required chest containing the Floater, guarded by an Eye.

evidence.quote: Going down this pit will lead you to Floor 2 (East) again, placed in a position to go grab the **required** chest containing the Floater; you'll have to fight an Eye when you step in front of the chest.

facts.subject: Floor 2 (East)
facts.text: To exit the Ice Cave after obtaining the Floater, fall down the pit in Floor 2 (East) to reach Floor 3 (West), navigate to Floor 1 (West), and climb the stairs in the top-right corner.

evidence.quote: Getting back out after getting the Floater will be a process; you'll have to fall down a pit in this room again to get back to Floor 3 (West), make it through that floor again, take the stairs back up to Floor 1 (West), and take the stairs leading up in the top-right corner of this area to leave the cave.

facts.subject: Airship
facts.text: Using the Floater summons the Airship, allowing players to fight Kary, Kraken, and Tiamat in any order without defeating further bosses to access the world.

evidence.quote: After using the Floater to summon the Airship [achievement 3576], you technically don't have to defeat any further bosses to open up the rest of the game world; the chain of progression items implies you should defeat the fiend of water and then the fiend of wind, but you can fight Kary, Kraken and Tiamat in any order if you wish.

facts.subject: Cardia Caves
facts.text: The Cardia island caves contain 13 chests across 3 caves, including one cave holding a Cabin, 575 G, and a Soft potion.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

facts.subject: Cardia Caves
facts.text: A second cave in the Cardia Isles contains 3 chests holding 10 G, a House, and 500 G.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

facts.subject: Cardia Caves
facts.text: A third cave in the Cardia Isles holds 7 chests containing 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G.

evidence.quote: There are 13 chests in total, spread across 3 caves (one with Cabin, 575 G, and Soft potion; one with 10 G, House, and 500 G; and a last one with 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, another 2750 G, 2000 G, and 1455 G).

facts.subject: Bahamut
facts.text: Bahamut is located in the Cardia Isles cave featuring a long hallway with a staircase leading down at the end.

evidence.quote: You'll find caves inhabited by Dragons (friendly ones, don't worry.) In one cave you'll find Bahamut, the King of the Dragons of Cardia.

He is located on the Cardia 
Islands, which is a rather simple maze.  To get to him, find the island with 2 
holes that's covered with forest.  His hole is on the bottom right of this 
island.

Find Bahamut in the Cardia Isles cave that's a long hallway with a staircase leading down at the end; if you have the Tail on hand, he'll grant your party a class upgrade, giving them the ability to use high-level equipment, the power to use magic (for knights and ninjas) or the higher tiers of magic that have thus far been inaccessible (for the mage classes), and the Black Belt gets... a different outfit, mostly.

facts.subject: Tail

evidence.quote: If you went out and got the Tail from the Castle of Ordeals, here's where you can turn in that seemingly important but also seemingly useless sidequest reward... if you have the Tail on hand, he'll grant your party a class upgrade, giving them the ability to use high-level equipment, the power to use magic (for knights and ninjas) or the higher tiers of magic that have thus far been inaccessible (for the mage classes), and the Black Belt gets... a different outfit, mostly.

facts.subject: Don't Change For Anyone

facts.subject: Magic Shops
facts.text: Magic levels 1 through 6 are sold across Coneria (level 1), Pravoka (level 2), Elfland (levels 3 and 4), Melmond (level 5), and Crescent Lake (level 6).

facts.subject: Level 7 Magic

facts.subject: Level 8 Magic
facts.text: Gaia sells three level 8 white and black magic spells each, while Lefein offers Lif2 for White Wizards and Nuke for Black Wizards.

evidence.quote: Gaia sells three level 8 white and black magic spells each. facts.subject: Waterfall Cave
facts.text: To reach Waterfall Cave, fly west from Cardia Isles to Onrac's continent, land on the bright green grass at the south end, and canoe straight up the river into the waterfall.

travel north up the river near
Onrac. You'll eventuallly run into the Waterfall.

facts.subject: Waterfall Cave

facts.subject: Bottled Fairy
facts.text: Purchasing the Bottled Fairy from the caravan west of Onrac and releasing it into the springs at Gaia rewards the party with Oxyale, allowing access to the submarine at Onrac.

evidence.quote: We've got no immediate options of things to do that don't require going to the Sea Shrine now, so purchase the Bottled Fairy from the caravan west of Onrac, release it in the springs at Gaia to receive Oxyale [achievement 3578], and go back to Onrac to take the submarine down to the Sea Shrine.

facts.subject: Floor 3 (West)
facts.text: Floor 3 (West) of the Sea Shrine contains two immediately available chests holding 9900 G and 2000 G.

evidence.quote: You enter the Sea Shrine on Floor 3 (West). There are two immediately available chests here (9900 G, 2000 G).

facts.subject: Floor 2
facts.text: The main portion of Floor 2 in the Sea Shrine contains 5 chests holding Opal Armor, 20 G, a Light Axe, a Mage Staff, and 12350 G.

evidence.quote: This brings you to the main portion of Floor 2, which contains 5 more treasures scattered around the rooms (Opal Armor, 20 G, Light Axe, Mage Staff, 12350 G).

facts.subject: Floor 1
facts.text: The northeast treasure room of Floor 1 in the Sea Shrine contains 3 chests holding an Opal Helmet, Opal Armor, and the required Slab.

evidence.quote: The treasure room that's only accessible from here contains 3 chests. The left one is an Opal Helmet, the middle one is Opal Armor, and the right one is the **Slab**, which you must get in order to unlock the next dungeon.

facts.subject: Floor 1
facts.text: Floor 1 of the Sea Shrine contains 10 additional chests holding 2750 G, 10000 G, 10 G, 4150 G, 5000 G, 9000 G, 1760 G, Opal Bracelet, Pure potion, and Opal Shield.

evidence.quote: After that, you can go back around the passage and collect the other 10 chests at your leisure (2750 G, 10000 G, 10 G, 4150 G, 5000 G, 9000 G, 1760 G, Opal Bracelet, Pure potion, Opal Shield).

facts.subject: Dr. Unne
facts.text: Taking the Slab to an NPC in Melmond allows the party to learn the language of Lefein and acquire the Chime.

evidence.quote: At this point, you don't actually need to finish the dungeon; once you have the Slab, you can learn the language of Lefein [achievement 3651] from an NPC in Melmond. Doing so will enable you to grab the Chime from Lefein and access the next dungeon, as well as hit up the last two magic shops in the game (see earlier notes on Of Mighty Magic [achievement 27656]).

facts.subject: Floor 3 (East)
facts.text: Floor 3 (East) of the Sea Shrine contains 2 chests out in the open holding 110 G and 450 G.

evidence.quote: Taking these will put you on Floor 2; walk around the square island to take another set of down stairs and enter Floor 3 (East), a relatively small area with 2 chests out in the open (110 G, 450 G).

facts.subject: Floor 4 (West)
facts.text: Floor 4 (West) of the Sea Shrine contains four treasure rooms holding a Ribbon, 9900 G, 7340 G, 2750 G, Light Axe, 7690 G, 8135 G, 5450 G, 385 G, and Power Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 (West) has four treasure rooms; the northeast one has 4 chests (Ribbon, 9900 G, 7340 G, 2750 G), the northwest one has one chest (Light Axe), southeast has 2 chests (7690 G, 8135 G), and southwest has 3 chests (5450 G, 385 G, Power Gauntlet).

facts.subject: Kraken
facts.text: Floor 5 of the Sea Shrine contains the path leading directly to the fiend Kraken.

evidence.quote: Floor 5 looks like it might have something to it, but there's nothing interesting except the path up to Kraken [achievement 3579].
